2. It is pointed out by the learned Prosecutor that the FIR got registered pursuant to the directions issued by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate under 156(3).

Because the Charge- Sheet had already been filed, the Petition was disposed of with the observations that now the Petition for quashing of FIR has become infructuous.
